newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin ends higher on increased demand.
newsitem.headline: KL tin ends higher on increased demand.

text.p: Tin price ended 11 cents higher at 15.19 ringgit ($6.09) a kg after a higher London market sparked off some shortcovering and improved buying from overseas, traders said.
"There were more buying from Europe, Japan and Malaysia," a dealer said, adding that the market's near-term trend would depend largely on the performance of the London market.
Turnover was 206 tonnes against 192 on Friday.
The local premium over London was unchanged at Friday's $5 a tonne.
